newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Spain protests at EU commissioner Gibraltar visit.
newsitem.headline: Spain protests at EU commissioner Gibraltar visit.

text.p: Spain protested formally to the European Commission on Tuesday over a visit last week to Gibraltar by Swedish Commissioner Anita Gradin, an EU diplomat said.

He said Spain's ambassador to the European Union had sent a letter to European Commission President Jacques Santer complaining about the visit in which Gradin studied how the British colony fights illegal drug trafficking from North Africa.
A spokesman for Gradin said she had not yet seen the letter but that the Commissioner, who is responsible for crime and judicial affairs in the Commission, had visited Gibraltar on November 4.
"It was a fact-finding mission," she said, adding that it included travelling on the high-speed boats used to chase smugglers' boats as they attempt to sneak into Europe.
Gradin had earlier been in Morocco.
Spain claims sovereignty over the colony at its southern tip which has been ruled by Britain for nearly 300 years.
